reference.title: Error Handling
reference.shortdesc: This section describes the process of error handling.

section.p: This section describes the process of error handling.
If a request to ADI OtoSense™ SMS REST API fails, the response will contain:

ul.li: A JSON object containing a short error message.

section.p: The API endpoint includes further details on the error and possible reasons and solutions. For more information on error codes, see HTTP Error Response Codes.
